newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar rallies after funds buy NY raws.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar rallies after funds buy NY raws.

text.p: A burst of fund buying in October raw sugar in New York gave London's equivalent whites contract a kick higher at the end of the week as the position regained most of the ground lost this month.
Commission house buying late on Thursday pushed October whites through initial trendline resistance at $324 but the raws strength propelled it higher still.
Trade and commission house players were cited as leading the buyers on Friday afternoon. October gained $2.30 to hit an intraday peak of $326.50.

The London market was injected with a fresh dose of bullish sentiment when October raws rallied through 11.65 cents/lb without running into too many of the producer sellers thought to be lurking at the higher levels.
It then racked up further gains to reach a high of 11.76, up 21 points.
On the whites, traders cited talk of Indonesian buying interest but this was unconfirmed.
At 1450 GMT October stood $2.30 at $326.50, its high of the day, and December up $1.40 at $323.00. But volume stayed on the thin side at just 824 lots.
The Paris market is closed due to a public holiday.
